name: peerova/peerova
description: Direct P2P networking (no relay, end-to-end encrypted) for PHP: ext/ffi binding over libpeerova + a pure-PHP sidecar fallback (peerova stdio).

suggest.ext-ffi: Native in-process binding (Peerova\Peerova). Without it use Peerova\PeerovaStdio (needs the peerova CLI binary).
